messages:
ops-lead: Starting green-swap for /v2/messages. Window 03:30-04:15 UTC. Steps: 3% -> 10% -> 25% -> drain -> 60% -> 100%. Hold 3m after 10% and 25%. Abort if p95 > +200ms or 5xx >0.6% sustained 2m. @tess you'll run node drains at 25%.

deploy-bot: job=start release=2026-03-21-gswap id=gs-4492. Posting confirmations.

tess: Roger. Watching logs and ready to cordon nodes at 25%.

deploy-bot: set-weight /v2/messages green=3% -> ok

alej: Telemetry: p95 baseline 88ms -> now 95ms, errors flat.

deploy-bot: set-weight /v2/messages green=10% -> ok

ops-lead: Proceed to 25%

deploy-bot: set-weight /v2/messages green=25% -> ok

tess: Draining old-blue nodes: `kubectl drain node-blue-7`

alej: Seeing p95 jump to 310ms and 503s from green pods. 5xx at 1.1% over 2m.

ops-lead: Abort. Rolling back to 10% and pin to blue.

deploy-bot: set-weight /v2/messages green=10% -> ok

deploy-bot: pin /v2/messages blue --reason "auto-rollback-timeouts" -> ok

tess: Uncordoning node-blue-7.

alej: Metrics recovering: p95 back to 97ms, 5xx 0.14%.

ops-lead: Action items: add auth timeout tests to preflight, exclude older infra from canary. I'll file follow-ups. Closing run."
